{{Top}}
The '''Apprentice Legislature''' was an organization for politically-minded youth. It had offices on many different [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Thesme]].

==History==
[[Vidar Kim]] became [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] mentor after completing his stint in the Apprentice Legislator program. Palpatine spent five years in the organization before being appointed as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Kim's [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] joined this group at the age of eight and achieved the position of [[Apprentice Legislator/Legends|Apprentice Legislator]] at the age of eleven.<ref name="DBPA">{{DB|character|amidala|Amidala, Padmé}}</ref> Amidala's friend and fellow Legislator, [[Silya Shessaun/Legends|Silya Shessaun]], first met her at a summit on Alderaan, and acted as her mentor during a week-long political workshop hosted by the organization.<ref name="DBSS">{{DB|character|silyashessaun|Shessaun, Silya}}</ref>
